title: All About My Mother (bc30)
synopsis: Following the tragic death of her teenage son, Manuela travels from Madrid to Barcelona in an attempt to contact the long-estranged father the boy never knew. She reunites with an old friend, an outspoken transgender sex worker, and befriends a troubled actress and a young nun. Hailed as one of his most iconic work, Almodóvar explores the profoundness and fortitude of motherhood in this tragic-comedy infused with the most vibrant colors and cinematic references.
